# Mago Vituco Productions

> International magic and live entertainment production for cruise ships and ferries, drawing on more than 15 years of maritime entertainment experience.

Mago Vituco Productions offers large-scale theatrical illusions, self-contained guest entertainer magic shows, close-up magic, and interactive magic and origami workshops for passengers. Formats are adapted to onboard operations and fly-on/fly-off scheduling.

## Official pages
- [English website](https://www.magovituco.com/): Company, services, showreel, experience and contact.
- [Spanish website](https://www.magovituco.com/es/): Spanish-language company and service information.
- [Sitemap](https://www.magovituco.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical language pages.

## Services and experience
- [Cruise ship magic shows](https://www.magovituco.com/cruise-ship-magic-shows/): Theatrical magic built around the rhythm of a cruise: visual illusions, audience participation and flexible formats for international passengers. Spanish: https://www.magovituco.com/es/magia-para-cruceros/
- [Grand illusion productions](https://www.magovituco.com/illusion-productions/): Large-format theatrical illusions for cruise entertainment teams looking for visual impact and a carefully planned stage production. Spanish: https://www.magovituco.com/es/grandes-ilusiones/
- [Guest entertainer magicians](https://www.magovituco.com/guest-entertainers/): Self-contained magic acts for cruise lines seeking adaptable guest entertainers, including fly-on/fly-off and resident opportunities. Spanish: https://www.magovituco.com/es/artistas-invitados/
- [Ferry entertainment](https://www.magovituco.com/ferry-entertainment/): Passenger entertainment adapted to ferry crossings, from short magical encounters to scheduled family activities. Spanish: https://www.magovituco.com/es/entretenimiento-para-ferris/
- [Onboard magic and origami workshops](https://www.magovituco.com/magic-workshops/): Participatory sessions that invite children, families and adults to discover magic and paper folding during their voyage. Spanish: https://www.magovituco.com/es/talleres-de-magia/
- [Immersive magic experiences](https://www.magovituco.com/magic-experiences/): Intimate close-up magic and surprise encounters designed to bring wonder beyond the ship’s theater. Spanish: https://www.magovituco.com/es/experiencias-de-magia/
- [Maritime entertainment consultancy](https://www.magovituco.com/entertainment-consultancy/): Creative development and practical planning for magic-based productions and onboard passenger experiences. Spanish: https://www.magovituco.com/es/consultoria-de-entretenimiento/
- [Magic productions and acts](https://www.magovituco.com/productions/): Explore our solo magic, theatrical illusions and variety acts for maritime entertainment and international stages. Spanish: https://www.magovituco.com/es/producciones/
- [International maritime entertainment experience](https://www.magovituco.com/experience/): More than 15 years of entertainment experience at sea, from resident productions to guest performances and passenger activities. Spanish: https://www.magovituco.com/es/trayectoria/
